name: starter-p1-reefer-otr-two-years
about: Starter P1 "From the driver's seat" on the opening-reefer-otr-two-years brief (the owner's copy rating, 2026-11-12).

details: Produce out of the valley to the Midwest

recipe.name: From the driver's seat
recipe.hook_formula: Say plainly what the run is, as if from the driver's seat: the lanes or the area, then the schedule or home time the brief states. If the brief states no lanes or area, say the kind of run (local, regional, over the road). Then what we need, if the brief states it (experience, licence, endorsements). No pay figure in the hook unless the brief states nothing else.
recipe.image_prompt_template: View through a truck windshield from the driver's seat, {viewpoint}, an open {road} ahead through {setting}, {light}, {weather}, no text, no logos, no lettering

en.primary_text: Over-the-road reefer runs hauling produce out of the valley to the Midwest. $0.70 to $0.78 per mile. Out 2 weeks, home 4 days. Class A, 23+.
en.headline: $0.70 to $0.78 per mile

es.primary_text: Rutas OTR con carga refrigerada: produce del valle al Medio Oeste. Pagamos de $0.70 a $0.78 por milla. Sales 2 semanas y descansas 4 días en casa. Licencia Clase A, mayores de 23.
es.headline: $0.70 a $0.78 por milla

en.primary_text: You run produce from the valley to the Midwest for 2 weeks, then you're home 4 days. Reefer, over the road. You get a 401k and a rider policy. Class A, age 23.
en.headline: 401k and rider policy

es.primary_text: Llevas produce del valle al Medio Oeste por 2 semanas y luego tienes 4 días en casa. Tráiler refrigerado, OTR. Tienes plan 401k y política de acompañante. Licencia Clase A, mayor de 23 años.
es.headline: 401k y acompañante

en.primary_text: Here's the run: you load produce in the valley, keep the reefer cold and deliver to the Midwest. Out 2 weeks, home 4 days. We need a Class A and 2 years of experience.
en.headline: Class A, 23+

es.primary_text: Así es la ruta: cargas produce en el valle, cuidas la temperatura del reefer y entregas en el Medio Oeste. Fuera 2 semanas, 4 días en casa. Buscamos Clase A con 2 años de experiencia.
es.headline: Clase A, mayores de 23
